# MCP Nim SDK

A Nim implementation of the [Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) (MCP): a client, a server, and the stdio and Streamable HTTP transports.

This checkout speaks MCP **2026-07-28** and every earlier version: `2024-11-05`, `2025-03-26`, `2025-06-18`, `2025-11-25`, `2026-07-28`. A client and a server settle on the newest version both speak; see [docs/versions.md](docs/versions.md).

## Install

Nim 2.2.2 or newer. In your `.nimble` file:

```nim
requires "https://github.com/jasagiri/mcp-nim-sdk#mcp-2026-07-28"
```

Then `import mcp`.

## A server

Serves one tool, `echo`, on stdin and stdout ([examples/stdio_server.nim](examples/stdio_server.nim)):

```nim
## An MCP server on stdin/stdout with one tool, `echo`.
##
##   nim c -r examples/stdio_server.nim
##
## Speaks the build's default protocol version and every earlier one. Stdout
## carries the protocol, so anything for people goes to stderr.

import std/[asyncdispatch, json, options]
import mcp

proc main() =
  let server = newMcpServer(
    McpServerInfo(name: "echo-server", version: "0.1.0"),
    capabilities = McpServerCapabilities(tools: some(McpToolsCapability())))

  let listTools: typeof(McpToolHandlers().listHandler.get) =
    proc(): Future[seq[JsonNode]] {.async.} =
      return @[%*{
        "name": "echo",
        "description": "Returns the text it is given",
        "inputSchema": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {"text": {"type": "string"}},
          "required": ["text"]}}]

  let callTool: typeof(McpToolHandlers().callHandler.get) =
    proc(name: string, arguments: JsonNode): Future[JsonNode] {.async.} =
      if name != "echo":
        raise newException(ValueError, "Unknown tool: " & name)
      return %*{"content": [{"type": "text", "text": arguments{"text"}.getStr()}],
                "isError": false}

  server.setToolHandlers(McpToolHandlers(
    listHandler: some(listTools), callHandler: some(callTool)))

  server.transport = newStdioTransport()
  waitFor server.processMessages()

main()
```

## A client

Starts that server as a child process, lists its tools and calls `echo` ([examples/stdio_client.nim](examples/stdio_client.nim)):

```nim
## An MCP client that starts a server as a child process, lists its tools and
## calls `echo`.
##
##   nim c examples/stdio_server.nim
##   nim c -r examples/stdio_client.nim examples/stdio_server

import std/[asyncdispatch, json, options, os]
import mcp

proc run(command: string, args: seq[string]) {.async.} =
  let client = newMcpClient(McpClientInfo(name: "echo-client", version: "0.1.0"))
  await client.connect(newProcessTransport(command, args))
  echo "connected, protocol version ", client.negotiatedVersion.get

  let listed = await client.sendRequest("tools/list", newJObject())
  if listed.error.isSome:
    raise newException(ValueError, "tools/list failed: " & listed.error.get.message)
  for tool in listed.result.get{"tools"}:
    echo "tool: ", tool{"name"}.getStr()

  let called = await client.sendRequest("tools/call",
    %*{"name": "echo", "arguments": {"text": "hello"}})
  if called.error.isSome:
    raise newException(ValueError, "tools/call failed: " & called.error.get.message)
  echo "echo says: ", called.result.get{"content"}{0}{"text"}.getStr()

  await client.close()

if paramCount() < 1:
  stderr.writeLine "usage: stdio_client SERVER_COMMAND [ARGS...]"
  quit(2)
waitFor run(paramStr(1), commandLineParams()[1 .. ^1])
```

```sh
nim c examples/stdio_server.nim
nim c -r examples/stdio_client.nim examples/stdio_server
```

The same pair over Streamable HTTP is in [examples/http_server.nim](examples/http_server.nim) and [examples/http_client.nim](examples/http_client.nim).

## Other versions

Each protocol version has a branch and a tag named `mcp-<version>`. Check one out, or name it in your `.nimble` file as above, and the SDK speaks that version and the earlier ones; its README, docs and examples describe exactly that version.

| Version | Branch | Handshake | This build |
|---|---|---|---|
| `2024-11-05` | `mcp-2024-11-05` | `initialize` | speaks |
| `2025-03-26` | `mcp-2025-03-26` | `initialize` | speaks |
| `2025-06-18` | `mcp-2025-06-18` | `initialize` | speaks |
| `2025-11-25` | `mcp-2025-11-25` | `initialize` | speaks |
| `2026-07-28` | `mcp-2026-07-28` | none, every request carries its metadata | speaks |
